reason: The native binding rejects a dateTime-only edit despite its optional timezone schema. A controlled same-event, same-instant request succeeds when timeZone is explicitly UTC. Remove this interface gotcha before fresh evaluation, rather than count it as scheduling difficulty.
change: Require dateTime and timeZone in each start/end schema and state the UTC serialization requirement in the initial observation. Keep task numbers, objective, action allowance, requested model settings, deadline and stopping rule unchanged.
calibration_transfer_caveat: The calibration cohort used the older optional-field schema. This clarification can change its transfer to fresh tasks; fresh outcomes are reported separately.
